office: Representative, Agusan del Norte Lone District
role: District Representative · Agusan del Norte, Lone District
summary: Agusan del Norte representative with 214 principal-authored bills. Authored a universal senior social pension, medicine support and discounts for senior citizens, calamity emergency leave and senior employment; co-authored the national minimum wage. Also authored higher campaign spending limits.
caveat: Evidence is concentrated on senior-citizen and labor benefits; single election-finance bill left unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored universal senior pension, medicine support and discounts (-3) and calamity emergency leave (-2); co-authored minimum wage (-2). Consistently state-funded benefits; no tax-side or privatization evidence.
